findings.body: The comparison runs only when the protection request succeeds. GitHub returns 404 when a branch has no protection (as `src/forge/init.py:111` documents), so a repo whose forge.toml names required checks but whose default branch requires none gets no mismatch warning. `forge doctor` can report that everything checks out while merges can bypass those checks. The new test covers only successful protection responses.
findings.title: Not done: CI waits for the team's checks

findings.body: A root `web/` directory alone makes `has_frontend` true. A backend-only service can use that directory for HTTP handlers, causing doctor to require both UI skills despite having no frontend. The changed tests even use an empty `web/` directory as the frontend signal. Check for actual frontend content or configuration before issuing the skill warnings.
findings.title: Treat a web directory as a frontend only when it contains one
